name: Cooeee Australia
summary: Sydney dialup ISP (Sydney + Perth POPs); dead ~2002-03.

events.details: ACN misattribution corrected: an earlier version cited COOEEE PTY LTD (ABN 19 126 600 351, ACN 126 600 351) as the operating entity. That company was not registered until 1 Aug 2007 - years after this ISP died c.2002-03 - and its only business name is a soccer academy (Golden Boot Strikers Academy, Blue Mountains NSW); it is an unrelated name collision and has been removed. No verified legal entity for the Cooeee dialup ISP is currently established.
